description: Create, update or delete files in a project (1–100 per call, each up to 1 MB; paths are relative, no `..`). Other files are left as they are. Overwrites and deletes are applied to the working files immediately — confirm with the user, and use list_checkpoints/restore_checkpoint to undo. Pass `version` (from get_project) to refuse the write if anything changed since you read it. The published site does not change until you deploy again.

content.description: Full file contents (send "" for a delete)

version.description: Optional: the project version you last read

name: write_project_files
